Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. You can't activate multiple digivolving effects at the same time.
Card Q&A.q: 2 copies of this card are in the battle area. Can I activate the [Your Turn] effect on both copies of this card and digivolve my Digimon into 1 [ADVENTURE] trait card with the digivolution cost reduced by 2?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.

[Your Turn] When any of your other [ADVENTURE] trait Digimon or Tamers are played, by suspending this Tamer, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into an [ADVENTURE] trait Digimon card in the hand. For every 2 of your Tamers' colors, reduce this effect's digivolution cost by 1.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
